title: 日本ダービーの後に・深淵に触れて

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (It was as if the passage of time itself slowed to a crawl.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Come oooon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I committed my heart and soul to that race, and as I ran, I felt nothing else but a desperate desire to win.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I just ran with everything I had. Forwards—to victory, to the goal.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I want to win… I want to win!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to defeat Yaeno and Chiyono O, right here and now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The sound of… glass fracturing? Are my legs… broken?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No, this is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (There's no doubt in my mind. In that crucial moment of contest, I pounded on those sealed gates—the limits holding me back!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (And yet… I couldn't quite make it through them, and failed to claim victory.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Argh! I couldn't do it! And I was so close to winning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It was in my hands! Losing wasn't an option!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That overwhelming desire to reach the finish line before them… It was that feeling that gave me a glimpse into a world of possibilities!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I had no idea! To think that a race could show me such a scene!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (If I could set foot into that world, then…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then my—our—light! It would become even—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Right now, I…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I forgot all about surpassing my older sister…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head out to meet with Mejiro Ardan after her excellent showing at the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I do apologize. I was unable to land you the title of Derby trainer.
choice_data_list: That's okay. Besides, you look pretty content.
That's okay. Besides, you look pretty content.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: I couldn't ask for anything more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan did the very best she could at the Japanese Derby. That's why, in this moment, she looks so liberated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I'm over the moon to see her like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I had an experience most peculiar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As I neared the finish line, an unfamiliar sensation welled up inside, as if the whole world was falling still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Amidst the silence, I could hear two things very clearly—Chiyono O and Yaeno's heartbeats, and the sound of their feet hitting the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With that rhythm drawing me in… I pounded on the gates holding me back—my own limits—and caught a glimpse of the new world that lies beyond them…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The sensation I felt in that moment—the firm belief that I can aim for even greater heights—lingers in my hands even now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And there was something else… Something that took even me by surprise…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It wasn't until the race was over… that I remembered my goal is to outshine my older sister…
choice_data_list: …That just goes to show that you were giving your all as you competed with your rivals.
…That just goes to show that you were giving your all as you competed with your rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Giving my all… with my rivals…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes… You're quite right…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Those two are my dearest friends… and my toughest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And not only that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's because I competed with everything I could muster—to the point that I forgot about my older sister…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And because they gave that race everything they had too…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That I was able to glimpse that world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always striven to seize the moment with her running, so today's discovery will likely change her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And it'll change me too. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Ardan's legs carry her to a new world of possibilities!
